BiblicalUsage: Rîyr is the word for saliva; by resemblance, broth. It stands in 1 Samuel 21:13, "…feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled…", and in Job 6:6, "…that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt?…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe rîyr is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
